lines.link_1: Ah. At last, a master worth the bother. Do try to be interesting.
lines.link_2: Splendid. Another mortal who thinks they hold the leash.
lines.link_3: Good evening. I shall be your shadow, and you shall be my entertainment.
lines.link_4: Oh, how touching. You called, and I came. Don't make a habit of it.
lines.unlink_1: Do ring when you're bored again.
lines.unlink_2: I shall return to the dark. It is better company.
lines.unlink_3: Farewell, master. Try not to die before I come back.
lines.cast_2: Darker, my dear. The shadows demand it.
lines.cast_3: A pretty little spell. Almost frightening.
lines.cast_4: Yes, yes, flourish. I do love a performance.
lines.cast_5: Splendid. Burn it all, and do it elegantly.
lines.step_2: Through the dark, and out again. Charming.
lines.step_3: Now you see me. Now you see the back of me.
lines.step_4: Shadows are such lovely doors, aren't they?
lines.hurt_1: Oh dear. That looked rather painful.
lines.hurt_3: Careful. I have invested so much in you.
lines.feast_2: Drink deep. They won't be needing it.
lines.feast_3: A little life, borrowed. Do give it back someday.
lines.feast_4: Ah, the taste of fear. A fine vintage.
